usedFor: Zoho POS rings up sales and TRIGGERcmd runs commands on your computers, so “New Invoice Added” can run “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice Added” in Zoho POS, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: Each new invoice starts a command on your own machine, so sales can kick off local jobs.

watchOut: “New Invoice Added” in Zoho POS is polling, so “Trigger Command” starts after a scheduled check.
